newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 2-wk rev repo,max rate 16.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 2-wk rev repo,max rate 16.2 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Wednesday set a two-week reverse repo tender to drain market liquidity at a maximum rate of 16.2 percent, down from 16.5 percent at a similar operation on Tuesday.
The CNB said in a statement that it would accept a maximum of two bids from each participants at a minimum of 100 million crowns per bid until 9.40 a.m. (0740 GMT).
In Tuesday's tender, average yield hit 16.47 percent, with all bids at the maximum rate satisfied.
